threads.body: In the `with_raw_response` path, `result.parse()` is called before checking `result.headers`. For raw-response objects, headers are available on the raw response itself (not guaranteed on the parsed payload), so parsing first can drop access to the served-model header and prevent `response_model_name` from being populated from `x-ms-served-model`. Extract the served model from the raw response *before* calling `parse()`, then fall back to `result.model` after parsing.

threads.body: The new tests validate `get_served_model()` in isolation, but there is no assertion that the instrumentation actually prefers the served-model header over `response.model` when present. Without an integration-style test (e.g., a small stub response object passed through the relevant extractor, or a cassette that includes `x-ms-served-model`), this behavior can regress silently.
